facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications and Digitalisation says the 2024 DigSMART Scale-Up, run with the Office of the Head of Civil Service and the Tony Blair Institute, trained 830 participants from 42 ministries, departments and agencies in three centres (Accra, Sunyani, Bolgatanga), after a 2023 pilot of 170 with a 70 percent graduation rate.

systems.platform: weekly online and monthly in-person sessions
